info.title: Five Questions Before Any Hearing Test
info.subtitle: Ask these wherever you book

rows.title: Is it free?
rows.desc: Costco says free for members 18 and older

rows.title: Do I need to book?
rows.desc: Costco says to contact the center to schedule

rows.title: What tests are included?
rows.desc: Ask which tests are in the visit

rows.title: Who does the test?
rows.desc: Ask who tests and what license they hold

rows.title: Do I get my audiogram?
rows.desc: Ask for a copy of your results
